SOULFORGER.Powers.adaptable-persona.Name: Adaptable Persona
SOULFORGER.Powers.adaptable-persona.Bene: Your selected armor grants a climb or swim Speed equal to your land Speed. From level 8, you can choose a fly Speed.
SOULFORGER.Powers.adaptable-persona.Flaw: You take a −10-foot penalty to all Speeds.
SOULFORGER.Powers.bounding-spirit.Name: Bounding Spirit
SOULFORGER.Powers.bounding-spirit.Benefi: The selected melee weapon gains thrown 30 feet and a returning rune, which does not count against its rune limit.
SOULFORGER.Powers.bounding-spirit.Flaw: After missing with a ranged or thrown weapon attack, make a new Strike against the ally nearest the original target. Use the previous multiple attack penalty (MAP); this Strike does not increase MAP.
SOULFORGER.Powers.deep-seated-fear.Name: Deep-Seated Fear
SOULFORGER.Powers.deep-seated-fear.Benef: You gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation. Demoralize has no language penalty against a target that perceives the essence. You can Demoralize as part of manifesting.
SOULFORGER.Powers.deep-seated-fear.Flaw: An attempt to Demoralize an enemy also affects your nearest ally.
SOULFORGER.Powers.determined-toughness.B: Status penalties from clumsy, drained, enfeebled, frightened, sickened, and stupefied are reduced by 1. Condition values and other consequences remain unchanged.
SOULFORGER.Powers.determined-toughness.F: The value of a listed condition that causes a status penalty increases by 1.
SOULFORGER.Powers.harmful-malice.Name: Harmful Malice
SOULFORGER.Powers.harmful-malice.Benefit: All your Strikes deal an additional 1d4 void damage. You gain one use of innate Harm at rank ceil(level / 2).
SOULFORGER.Powers.harmful-malice.Flaw: All damage you deal is reduced by floor(level / 2).
SOULFORGER.Powers.heroic-heart.Name: Heroic Heart
SOULFORGER.Powers.heroic-heart.Benefit: You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception, saving throws, and skill checks.
SOULFORGER.Powers.heroic-heart.Flaw: You take a −1 status penalty to attack rolls.
SOULFORGER.Powers.healing-grace.Name: Healing Grace
SOULFORGER.Powers.healing-grace.Benefit: You gain fast healing floor(level / 2) and one use of innate Heal at rank ceil(level / 2).
SOULFORGER.Powers.healing-grace.Flaw: Healing you receive and healing you provide with spells are reduced by floor(level / 2).
SOULFORGER.Powers.magical-resilience.Ben: You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and saving throws against spells. From level 5, you gain one use of innate Dispel Magic at rank ceil(level / 2) − 1.
SOULFORGER.Powers.magical-resilience.Fla: You take a −1 status penalty to AC and saving throws against spells.
SOULFORGER.Powers.planar-bond.Name: Planar Bond
SOULFORGER.Powers.planar-bond.Benefit: You gain resistance to the selected damage type equal to your level + 2.
SOULFORGER.Powers.planar-bond.Flaw: You gain weakness 1 to all damage.
SOULFORGER.Powers.planar-pain.Name: Planar Pain
SOULFORGER.Powers.planar-pain.Benefit: The selected weapon’s physical damage changes to the selected damage type; you gain a +2 status bonus to damage with that weapon.
SOULFORGER.Powers.planar-pain.Flaw: When you deal damage with a weapon or unarmed attack, you take 2 damage of the last selected type, even if that type would not normally harm you.
SOULFORGER.Powers.pull-of-stasis.Name: Pull of Stasis
SOULFORGER.Powers.pull-of-stasis.Benefit: On a hit with the selected weapon, the target takes a −10-foot penalty to all Speeds for 1 round. On a critical hit, the target is immobilized for 1 round instead.
SOULFORGER.Powers.pull-of-stasis.Flaw: You take a −10-foot penalty to all Speeds.
SOULFORGER.Powers.reflecting-spirit.Name: Reflecting Spirit
SOULFORGER.Powers.reflecting-spirit.Bene: You gain a +2 status bonus to AC against physical ranged attacks. After one misses, a reaction reflects damage of the same type equal to half your shield’s Hardness.
SOULFORGER.Powers.reflecting-spirit.Flaw: You gain weakness 5 to physical ranged attacks.
SOULFORGER.Powers.resolute-defiance.Name: Resolute Defiance
SOULFORGER.Powers.resolute-defiance.Bene: The selected shield gains +2 Hardness and an increase to current and maximum HP equal to your level + 2 for the essence’s duration. Damage consumes the added HP first. You gain Shield Block if you do not already have it.
SOULFORGER.Powers.resolute-defiance.Flaw: When blocking damage, automatically attempt a DC 5 flat check before the block is applied. On failure, drop the shield, remove Raise a Shield, and apply damage without Shield Block reduction. Taking damage with a raised shield also triggers a check.
SOULFORGER.Rule.Language: No language penalty if the target perceives the essence. All other Demoralize requirements still apply.
SOULFORGER.Rule.Stasis: Pull of Stasis: on a hit, −10 feet to all Speeds for 1 round; on a critical hit, immobilized for 1 round. Apply the effect using the button on its trigger card.
SOULFORGER.Stasis.SlowedDescription: −10 feet to all Speeds for 1 round.
SOULFORGER.Item.HelperDescription: Helper effect. Applying it opens the module’s essence selection dialog.
SOULFORGER.Item.CorruptionDescription: Free action. Click Use and choose an essence power’s corruption flaw. The flaw lasts until its effect is removed. It does not expend the essence form’s daily use.
SOULFORGER.Item.ManifestDescription:
Free action. Frequency: once per day.

Click Use, choose an essence power, and select eligible equipment if needed. The effect lasts 1 minute. Cancelling any dialog preserves the use.

This ability also grants the Apply Corruption Flaw free action.

In this custom version, you choose the power each time you use the ability, and manifestation is a free action.
